title: Russian Buckwheat Pilaf with Fresh Herbs
description: A hearty and flavorful Russian-inspired pilaf dish made with buckwheat groats, fresh herbs, and a touch of unique spices. Perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the buckwheat groats and stir to coat with oil and mix with onion and garlic.
Add the chopped fresh herbs, unique spice blend, and salt. Stir well to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the buckwheat is tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
Garnish with additional fresh herbs, if desired.
